wiki.title: It's Your Funeral Home & Crematorium
wiki.body:
The funeral home next door to Bob's Burgers, run by the Belchers' mild-mannered friend and neighbor **Mort**.

## Notes
- Source of the infamous 'human flesh burgers' rumor in the very first episode
- Mort is a regular at Bob's counter

wiki.title: It's Your Funeral Home & Crematorium
wiki.body:
The door is locked — Mort must be in the back.

**This interior hasn't been built yet.** Want to model it? This site is a community project: every location is a JSON manifest plus a low-poly model, added by pull request. See the repo README for how to contribute.
